kjv: ought the woman to have power on [her] head
mine: a wife ought to have authority on her head
note: exousia is authority; the KJV margin and later readers took it as a "sign of [her husband's] power", i.e. a veil, which the Greek does not say.

kjv: Take, eat: this is my (Jesus') body, which is broken for you
mine: This is my (Jesus') body, which is for you
note: TR adds "Take, eat" (from Mt 26:26) and "broken" (klomenon); absent from P46, Sinaiticus*, A, B, C*.

kjv: he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body
mine: anyone who eats and drinks without discerning the body eats and drinks judgment on himself
note: TR adds "anaxios" (unworthily) and "tou kyriou" (of the Lord); and "krima" is "judgment", which 11:30–32 explains as illness and discipline "so that we may not be condemned". "Damnation" has kept many from communion.
